config_locations: ~/.kimi/config.json (legacy, migrated to config.toml on first load; backup at config.json.bak)
KIMI_SHARE_DIR/config.toml (when KIMI_SHARE_DIR env var is set, overrides ~/.kimi)
CLI --config <TOML/JSON string> (inline config text loaded via load_config_from_string)
config_loader: Custom Pydantic v2 BaseModel hierarchy (no pydantic-settings). load_config() reads the file as text, dispatches to json.loads() for .json files or tomlkit.loads() for .toml, then validates via Config.model_validate(data). save_config() serializes with Config.model_dump(mode='json') and writes TOML via tomlkit.dumps() or JSON via json.dumps(). A one-time migration (_migrate_json_config_to_toml) converts legacy config.json to config.toml and preserves a .bak backup. Pydantic field_serializer dumps SecretStr api_key values to plaintext on JSON serialization. Env-var overrides are applied post-load in augment_provider_with_env_vars() / create_llm(), not during validation.
session_format: JSON Lines (jsonl). Message history in context.jsonl: one kosong.message.Message per line. Wire/UI events in wire.jsonl: WireFileMetadata header line + JSON-encoded WireMessageRecord {timestamp, message: WireMessageEnvelope}. Session state in state.json: single JSON object of Pydantic SessionState model. Global metadata kimi.json: JSON object with work_dirs array.
session_storage: Centralized under get_share_dir() = $KIMI_SHARE_DIR or ~/.kimi. Sessions are scoped per work directory: ~/.kimi/sessions/<md5(workdir_path)>/<session_uuid>/ where each session dir holds context.jsonl, wire.jsonl, state.json. Legacy sessions lived directly at ~/.kimi/sessions/<uuid>.jsonl. Global metadata at ~/.kimi/kimi.json maps work dirs to sessions_dir and last_session_id. OAuth tokens persisted at ~/.kimi/credentials/oauth/<key>.json (keyring deprecated/migrated). Device ID at ~/.kimi/device_id. Logs at ~/.kimi/logs/kimi.log. Config at ~/.kimi/config.toml.
state_management: Hybrid in-memory + disk. Context (soul/context.py) holds in-memory _history (list[Message]), _token_count, _pending_token_estimate, _next_checkpoint_id, _system_prompt; restored from context.jsonl on startup, appended incrementally per message, and rotated via next_available_rotation() on revert/clear (atomic file swap). SessionState (session_state.py) is a Pydantic model persisted as state.json per session dir with atomic_json_write; covers approval flags, plan mode, title, archive, todos. Metadata (metadata.py) is a Pydantic model persisted as kimi.json (work_dirs registry with last_session_id). OAuthManager caches access tokens in-memory (_access_tokens dict) with refresh-token on disk under credentials/oauth/. Web UI (web/store/sessions.py) adds a cache-aside layer: module-level _sessions_cache + _sessions_index_cache with 5s TTL, invalidated on write via invalidate_sessions_cache(). Cross-process token refresh coordinated via file-based flock on credentials/*.lock.
proposal: kimi-cli models config as a flat Pydantic BaseModel validated from a hand-parsed TOML/JSON source (custom load_config), with env-var overrides applied imperatively after loading rather than declaratively. ai-factory could emulate a cleaner pydantic-v2 pattern: a nested BaseSettings (pydantic-settings) model whose env-prefixed fields auto-bind to KIMI_* env vars with validation, combined with per-session Pydantic models (Config + SessionState) persisted as JSON/Toml via model_validate/model_dump. This gives declarative env wiring, type-checked config, and a single validation boundary while preserving kimi-cli-style atomic JSON state files and the md5-scoped session directory layout. A session dataclass holding in-memory Message history backed by an append-only JSONL context file + a checkpoint/revert rotation strategy would mirror kimi-cli's Context class without its bespoke file-replay logic.
